title: feat(console): the empty ⌘K palette leads with the current page's favorites entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Part of #36286
Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new published language-pack key, in all eleven packs: console.commandPalette.currentPage
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在应用的列表页或记录页按 ⌘K、什么都不输入时，面板最上面多一组「当前页面」，里面是「添加到收藏」（已收藏时是「从收藏中移除」）；其它页面和输入文字后都不变。
- 这是「搜索面板对标 Attio」那张卡的第二步；本次只做了收藏这一项，「新建视图」和「编辑」没有做，等定做法。
- 出错最多是这一行不出现或收藏没加上，页面自己的收藏星标照常能用；可以直接撤回，不影响数据。
- 要你做的：定「新建视图」「编辑」两项是否让列表页和记录页把自己的按钮登记给面板（要改这两个页面）。

## What changes

Item 5 of the card ("current page" group on the empty palette), the part that has an entry point the palette can reach today: the favorites entry. The other two rows the card names, **New view** (list page) and **Edit** (record page), are **not** built here; see Acceptance notes. Hence `Part of`, not a closing keyword: merging this must not close the card.

- **New "Current page" group**, first on the empty in-app palette, only while nothing is typed (`PaletteCurrentPage.tsx`, beside the palette).
  - **On an object's list** (`/apps/APP/OBJECT`, or `/apps/APP/OBJECT/view/VIEW`): "Add to favorites" / "Remove from favorites", running the list's own ⋮ More favorites entry, `useObjectListFavorite`, with the plural title the list is drawn under (`servedObjectPluralLabel`). Same hook, same inputs, so it pins the app's navigation entry where the app has one and keeps an `object:` favorite otherwise, exactly as the menu does.
  - **On a record page** (`.../OBJECT/record/ID`, and its named-page route): the record's star. The favorite item the record page builds is now one exported function, `recordFavoriteItem` in the favorites module (`FavoritesProvider.tsx`); the record page and the palette both call it, so both toggle the same `record:OBJECT:ID` entry. The label is the title the record was last visited under (the page records that visit under the same id), else the id, which the page heals on its next visit as before.
  - The page is read off the address against the console's own route table (`APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS`, the `objectViewRouteObject` matcher), so `search`, `reports`, `.../new`, `.../data`, `.../record/ID/edit` and dashboards draw no group; an object the console does not serve opens the not-found state, which offers no favorites entry, so it draws none either.
  - Visibility follows the page: both entries are drawn on those pages with no permission condition (the ⋮ More entry and the record star have none), so the palette adds none.
- **Enter hint**: the row's value starts with `favorite-add` / `favorite-remove`; the footer says "Add to favorites ↵" / "Remove from favorites ↵", reusing the menu's existing `common.addToFavorites` / `common.removeFromFavorites` keys.
- **One new published key**, `console.commandPalette.currentPage` ("Current page"), in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`).
- Untouched, per the card: what the search searches and how it ranks, the full search page, no Ask-AI entry, the phone's search.

Read first (risk order):

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/PaletteCurrentPage.tsx` — the page matcher and the group; the `listFavorite` / record branch is where "same entry as the page" lives.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` — one hunk: `favoriteRecord` now calls `recordFavoriteItem` (byte-identical item).
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` — the group is mounted above the recent records, only for an empty query.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the card's existing harness file `CommandPalette.previewCreate-36286.test.tsx` (the shared harness for this card's palette pins, so the new pins go there rather than a new file), real `CommandPaletteProvider` + `FavoritesProvider` + `RecentItemsProvider`:

- list page: the group is first, its row selected, the footer says Add to favorites; Enter turns the list's own entry (`useObjectListFavorite`, probed beside the palette) on, as the `nav:` pin, and does not navigate;
- a named view of the list is the list;
- record page: Enter stores exactly `recordFavoriteItem(app, object, id, visitedTitle)`;
- an already-starred record offers Remove from favorites and Enter takes it off;
- typing removes the group, clearing brings it back;
- CONTROL: no group on the app landing, a dashboard, the search page, a create form, an unserved object;
- the route matcher and the two footer kinds.

No existing test was changed.

<details><summary>Local runs (head 9e9556611b, after merging origin/main 0b2118f49c)</summary>

- `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/chrome/ packages/i18n/` + the favorites / record-page / route-reads pins (`RecordDetailView.favoritesEntry-12427`, `.phoneFace-27058`, `.recordPageTiers-26678`, `.printPageHeaderActions-12906`, `ObjectView.favoritesEntry-12427`, `FavoritesProvider.test`, `appRouteMetadataReads-12809`): Test Files 142 passed (142), Tests 2257 passed, 13 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` + `tsconfig.test.json`): VERDICT command-exit 0 (at 6b01f4f6f8, before the merge).
- Ablation (one, on the tested behaviour), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the record row's toggle rewritten to store a palette-own id (`palette:record:…`). Anchor x1 to x0, blob b6ae734d to f104aa13; the file goes red, 2 failed / 25 passed ("on a record page: Enter stars the record…", "a record already starred offers to take the star off"); restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- ESLint `--no-inline-config` on the changed files: 0 errors; warning counts equal to main except `FavoritesProvider.tsx` +1 and the new `PaletteCurrentPage.tsx` 1, both `react-refresh/only-export-components` for the exported pure function, the same warning `withFavoriteOrder` already carries there.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **New view and Edit are not built.** Neither has an entry point the palette can call from where it is mounted (the console frame, beside the routes): "Add view" is the view switcher's in-place create card, page state inside `ObjectView`; the record page's Edit either enters the page's edit state or opens the form, and its visible/disabled verdict is computed inside `RecordDetailView` from the loaded record (approval lock, `edit.disabledWhen`, state lock, edit-state eligibility). Re-deriving either in the palette would be a second verdict, which the dispatch rules out. The sound shape is the page advertising its own handler to the palette while it is mounted, as `advertisedShortcuts` and `usePublishPhonePageBar` already do, which edits both pages and is outside this claim's file surface. Held for a decision.
- "Favorite this view" is the list page's favorites entry (its ⋮ More, which favorites the list), not the per-view star in the view switcher; the per-view star needs the open view's id and the switcher's view list, which also live inside the page.
- The group's row is now the first entry of the empty palette, so Enter on an empty palette over a list or record page toggles the favorite rather than opening the most recent record. This matches the card ("在最上面") and the footer says it.
- A record opened in the drawer over a list (`?recordId=`) is still the list page to the palette: it offers the list's favorite, not the record's.
- A host route (`extraRoutes`) whose path shadows an object name is not consulted: the palette is not handed `hostRoutePaths`. An object of that name would draw the list favorite there.
- `ui/AGENTS.md` asks a feature to update the package README; the README is outside this claim's file surface and is not edited.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open any object's list in the console, press ⌘K without typing. Expected: "Current page" first, "Add to favorites" selected, footer "Add to favorites ↵"; Enter adds the list to the sidebar's Favorites. On a record page the same row fills the star beside the record's name.

Showcase app on its own fresh backend and the console dev server, Chromium at 1440×900:

List page, empty palette:

![list page](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/baeb6aa086f45fd347904971302e07594deaf264/01-list-page.png?raw=true)

Record page, empty palette:

![record page](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/baeb6aa086f45fd347904971302e07594deaf264/03-record-page.png?raw=true)

Record page after Enter: the page's own star is filled and the sidebar lists the record under Favorites:

![record page after Enter](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/baeb6aa086f45fd347904971302e07594deaf264/04-record-page-after-enter.png?raw=true)

Same run, read off the page: the stored favorites were `record:showcase_account:1MzJPKSv7BryLV8V` labelled "Stark Industries" and the list's `nav:nav_accounts` pin; reopened, the row read "Remove from favorites"; typing "stark" removed it. Screenshots live on the code-free ref `claude/issue-36286-current-page-screenshots`, which can be deleted after merge.
